title: Merchant overview shows 'Same day*' and '$0' monthly with the conditions left off the page
recommendation: Put the asterisk's footnote under the card ('*Into Alderwick business checking for batches closed by 9 p.m. ET; next business day to any other bank - no Alderwick account required'), show the PCI non-compliance fee next to 'Monthly fee $0' ('$0; $19.95/mo only if PCI not validated'), and add a worked example ('$15,000 a month in person = about $X, plus a terminal from $349 if you need one').

title: The application doesn't say up front that funding can wait, so a switcher without her old bank's details may stop before she finds out
recommendation: On step 1, under 'About 10 minutes', add one line: 'You'll need ID and your SSN or ITIN. You can fund now or within 30 days, so no other bank details are needed to apply.' Show the 30-day option as a hint under Funding in the progress bar.

title: The checking comparison table leaves out conditions and fees the product page states
recommendation: Write the waiver row as '$500+ in direct deposits per statement cycle, or $1,500 daily balance, or age 17-24', add an 'Other fees' row (paper statements $3/month, $0 for e-statements or 65+), and replace 'easy waiver' on the application card with the actual waiver conditions.

title: The CD early-withdrawal penalty sits at the bottom of the rates page, past mortgages, loans and cards
recommendation: Add the penalty to the CD intro line ('Fixed for the term. Early withdrawal: 90 days of interest for 12 months or less, 180 days for longer terms.') and link to /personal/cds.

title: The home page speaks only to personal checking; business, wealth and rate seekers must find the menu
recommendation: Add a row of entry points directly under the hero (Business banking and merchant services; Today's rates including the 12-month CD; Private banking, talk to a relationship manager), visible on the first phone screen once the cookie box is dismissed.

title: The required consent checkbox on the wealth form has a near-invisible border
recommendation: Give unchecked checkboxes and radios a border of at least 3:1 (for example the body grey #5c6c6c), enlarge the box to 24 px, and make the whole label a visible click target.

title: Nothing on the wealth path says who qualifies for private banking
recommendation: State the private banking threshold, or 'There's no minimum to talk to us', beside the asset question and on the Wealth menu promo.

title: Rate tables on a phone are cut off at the right edge with no sign they scroll
recommendation: Stack those tables into cards below 600 px, or add a visible scroll shadow or label and keep the APR column in view.

title: The site header hides the comparison table's column names while scrolling
recommendation: Offset the table's sticky header by the site header's height (about 108 px on desktop) so column names stay fully visible.

title: The application page opens partway down and then jumps to the top, so the first tap misses
recommendation: Reset scroll to the top instantly (not smoothly) on route change, so /open first paints at the top.
